common.selectProjectFirst: Select a project in the sidebar first

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Pick a project to open its workspace — cases, runs, PRDs and envs live under it
projects.empty: No projects yet — create one from the top right
projects.deleteHint: Its envs, cases, runs, PRDs and artifact files will be deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
projects.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the project name to confirm

sidebar.projectSwitched: Previous project is unavailable, switched to "{{name}}"

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Models, server and interface preferences — shared by chat and the agents
settings.defaultModelHint: Only multimodal (vision) models can be the default — agents and chat send screenshots.
settings.browserPoolHint: Warm chromium instances kept between runs (0 = launch per run). Each instance costs ~0.6-1 GB of memory; the server caps the value at 4. A settings change applies without a restart.
settings.serverHint: Apply to reconnect to the gRPC server
settings.browserEngineHint: Exactly one engine is active. Playwright uses Chromium only (Firefox/WebKit are not installed) and records full evidence (video + trace). An engine that is not installed disables the browser tools — the server never falls back to the other one.
settings.browserEngineObscuraHint: Obscura is auto-downloaded on first use and runs over CDP. Current limitation: no video/trace evidence — runs keep per-step screenshots and live frames only.

cases.title: Cases
cases.empty: No cases yet — upload materials to draft some
cases.creator: Creator
cases.noReviewActions: No actions available in this status
cases.noVerdict: No verdict produced at stream end
cases.deleteConfirm: Delete case "{{title}}"? Cases referenced by runs cannot be deleted.
cases.alignmentRequired: At least one alignment is required — a case without alignment rules can never be run
cases.alignmentRuleRequired: Every alignment needs a non-empty rule
cases.goalPlaceholder: What the agent must verify (UI ↔ API ↔ backend agree)

history.title: Run history
history.subtitle: Every recorded run of the project — filter by env, case, status and date
history.empty: No runs match the current filters

runPanel.title: Live run
runPanel.traceHint: trace viewer opens via playwright show-trace
runPanel.liveEnded: No live frames for this run

envs.title: Environments
envs.subtitle: Each env binds one SUT address set plus injected variables
envs.limitsHint: Override the agent hard limits; leave blank for defaults
envs.limitsInvalid: Agent limits must be non-negative integers
envs.empty: No envs yet — create one top-right

prd.title: Materials
prd.subtitle: Upload materials (PRDs, example data, notes); the analyze agent drafts cases for review
prd.traceEmpty: Agent parse events appear here after you upload a file
prd.reviewHint: Queued as pending; review them in the Cases view
prd.formatsHint: Supports .md / .docx / .pdf; files are uploaded and parsed server-side

api.title: APIs
api.subtitle: gRPC methods parsed from the project's proto assets — expand for message schemas and invoke against an env
api.envHint: Pick an env to invoke methods directly from here (target: the env's gRPC address)
api.empty: No methods yet — upload a proto asset in Materials first

asset.title: Assets
asset.subtitle: Upload PRDs or proto API definitions — parsed API docs are globally readable by this project's agents
asset.prdHint: A single .md / .docx / .pdf — the analyze-agent drafts cases from it
asset.protoHint: One or more .proto files (imports supported) — parsed into an API doc that also constrains agents to defined APIs only
asset.entryHint: The entry file is the main definition no other file imports; required for multi-file bundles
asset.noApiDoc: This asset has no API doc
asset.batchDeleteConfirm: Delete {{count}} selected asset(s)? This cannot be undone.
asset.empty: No assets yet — upload one from the top right
asset.noTextPreview: No text preview available for this document (legacy data or unsupported format); re-upload to enable it

chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Ask about system state: AI answers from a live snapshot
chat.initialHint: Ask about the system state, or pick a quick question below — the transcript is saved per session
chat.placeholder: Ask a question, e.g. what is running right now?
chat.qOverview: Give me a system status overview
chat.qRunning: Which tasks are running right now?
chat.qRecent: What cases ran recently, and how did they go?
chat.qEnvs: What environments exist and how are they configured?
